grain: One row per charity (identified by ABN) for the 2024 Annual Information Statement reporting year, carrying that charity's registration details, AIS lodgement dates, activity descriptions, staffing/volunteer counts, financial-report classification and reported financial figures for its own reporting period (period start/end dates appear as separate columns, so the financial figures are period-specific rather than calendar-2024).

groups.name: charity_identity_and_registration
groups.purpose: Core charity identity and ACNC registration status: ABN key, name, website, registration status, basic religious charity flag, incorporated association flag and the state association numbers held by the charity.

groups.name: ais_lodgement_and_reporting_classification
groups.purpose: Regulatory lodgement and reporting classification: AIS due/received dates, charity size band, financial-report period dates, statement type, modification flags and consolidation/cash-basis indicators.
columns: report consolidated with more than one entity
coop financial report submitted to regulator

groups.name: activities_and_programs
groups.purpose: Narrative and flag description of what the charity did in the period: whether activities were conducted, how purposes were pursued, reasons for no activity, and international activity flags and descriptions.
columns: why charity did not conduct activities
international activities undertaken - operating overseas including programs
international activities undertaken - transferring goods or services overseas

groups.name: fundraising_registrations
groups.purpose: State-by-state and online fundraising activity flags together with the corresponding fundraising licence/registration numbers held by the charity.

groups.name: workforce_and_volunteers
groups.purpose: Staffing and volunteer headcounts reported by the charity, including full-time, part-time, casual and volunteer counts and total full-time-equivalent staff.

groups.name: income_and_revenue
groups.purpose: Reported income and revenue lines for the charity's own reporting period: total gross income, total revenue and its components (government, goods and services, investments, donations and bequests, other revenue, other income) plus other comprehensive income.

groups.name: expenses_and_grants_made
groups.purpose: Reported expense lines and outbound grants/donations made by the charity for its own reporting period, including employee, interest and other expenses and grants for use in and outside Australia.
columns: grants and donations made for use in Australia
grants and donations made for use outside Australia

groups.name: assets_and_liabilities
groups.purpose: Reported balance-sheet position for the charity's own reporting period: current and non-current assets and liabilities, loans payable/receivable, net assets/liabilities and the narrative assets and liabilities description.

groups.name: key_management_and_related_parties
groups.purpose: Related-party and key management personnel disclosures: whether reportable related party transactions exist, the nature of those transactions, KMP flag and headcount, total paid to KMP, and free-text other details.
columns: charity has reportable related party transactions
Total paid to Key Management Personnel

entity_types.name: charity
entity_types.definition: A registered charity lodging an Annual Information Statement with the ACNC, identified by its ABN; its legal form is not inferred from its name.

entity_types.name: fundraising_authorisation
entity_types.definition: A state or territory fundraising registration/licence number held by a charity, evidenced by a fundraising number column for that jurisdiction.

charity.rationale: ABN is the only stable identifier for the row subject; charity name is free text and must not be used as a key.

fundraising_authorisation.rationale: Each populated fundraising number column evidences a jurisdiction-specific fundraising registration held by the charity; the number is the only identifier present.

relationship_types.name: HOLDS_FUNDRAISING_AUTHORISATION
relationship_types.definition: Charity holds a state or territory fundraising registration evidenced by a fundraising number column for that jurisdiction.

relationships.rationale: Fundraising number columns (act, nsw, qld, sa, tas, vic, wa) are populated only for charities holding that jurisdiction's fundraising registration; the corresponding fundraising flag columns indicate activity, not the authorisation itself.

cautions: ABN is the only stable identifier; charity name is free text and must not be used as a join key or to infer legal form.
Financial figures relate to each charity's own reporting period (fin report from/to), not a common financial year; cross-row comparison without checking those dates is unsafe.
Charity size (Small/Medium/Large) is a reporting classification, not company scale or legal form; blanks and zeros for small charities are not evidence of nil activity.
Registration status and AIS due/received dates describe regulatory lodgement, not business incorporation or a licence date.
Association numbers and fundraising numbers are state-specific registrations; their presence does not establish company legal form or a single national licence.
Numeric columns are stored without units or percent signs; fraction-versus-percentage storage cannot be confirmed from the visible bytes.
Some charities have withheld information and are excluded, so absence of a row is not evidence a charity does not exist.
The dataset is refreshed weekly; the local snapshot is a point-in-time copy.
